name: mfe-ecommerce-shared-cart
description: Dev convenience launcher only — each app (host/catalog-mfe/cart-mfe/wishlist-mfe/auth-mfe) remains independent with its own package.json and can be run/deployed on its own.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n catalog,cart,wishlist,auth,host -c blue,magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npm --prefix catalog-mfe run dev" "npm --prefix cart-mfe run dev" "npm --prefix wishlist-mfe run dev" "npm --prefix auth-mfe run dev" "npm --prefix host run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix catalog-mfe run build && npm --prefix cart-mfe run build && npm --prefix wishlist-mfe run build && npm --prefix auth-mfe run build && npm --prefix host run build
scripts.deploy:simulate: concurrently -k -n catalog,cart,wishlist,auth,host -c blue,magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npx serve catalog-mfe/dist -p 5001 --no-clipboard" "npx serve cart-mfe/dist -p 5002 --no-clipboard" "npx serve wishlist-mfe/dist -p 5003 --no-clipboard" "npx serve auth-mfe/dist -p 5004 --no-clipboard" "npx serve host/dist -p 5000 --no-clipboard"
